title: Fix MCP and issue-path error mapping gaps
description: From the 2026-08-15 complete code audit: (a) MCP `catchDiag` (src/mcp/server.ts:32-38) does not map `ZodError` to `schema_invalid`, unlike CLI `diagnosticFor` (src/cli/index.ts:1044-1047) — e.g. an invalid `post_message` kind returns `unexpected_error`. (b) `issueFile` (src/core/issue.ts:99-109) throws raw `Error` for unsafe ids instead of `MutationError`/a coded diagnostic, so invalid ids surface as `unexpected_error` at every surface. Fix both: add ZodError mapping in `catchDiag`, and make the unsafe-issue-id path throw a coded error.
acceptance: An MCP call with an invalid enum/kind (e.g. a bad `post_message` kind or `create_task` status) returns `schema_invalid`, not `unexpected_error`.

`createIssue`/`updateIssue`/`closeIssue` with an unsafe id (e.g. containing slashes or `..`) returns a coded diagnostic (`schema_invalid` or `invalid_transition`), not `unexpected_error`, across CLI, MCP, and dashboard.
All checks green: `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run check`, `waystation validate`.
